title: TrustSet
key_points: The TrustSet transaction allows a trust account to set trusted and untrusted addresses.
The owner field specifies the address of the account that can manage this trust set.
If no flags are set, both trusted and untrusted fields default to an empty array.
The Account ID field identifies which account's trust relationships will be modified or viewed.
limitations: Scope is limited to the XRPL protocol documentation
asserts: The TrustSet transaction enables trust accounts to set trusted and untrusted addresses, with the owner field specifying the managing account.
scope: Context of the TrustSet transaction within the XRPL protocol
